turns.text: Hey Lloyd, can you check if my python script for the RSSC meeting is still compiling? I think I broke the import path.
I can check that for you. Could you paste the error message or the script content here?
It's just a missing module warning. Oh, and don't forget, for the intro slide, make sure to spell out RSSC stands for Robotics & Software Study Club.
Got it. I'll make sure the full name is on the slide. Do you want a specific font size for it?
No, standard is fine. Also, did the package of mechanical keyboards I ordered arrive yet? I need one for the demo.
I don't have access to your personal email, so I can't check the tracking number directly. Did you check the carrier site?
Not yet, I'll check later. Just focus on the slide for now. Thanks.
Understood. I'm ready to help with the slide text whenever you are.
Lloyd, I'm trying to archive some old meeting recordings. Do you remember the policy for posting them?
I don't have a specific policy stored from our past chats. Could you remind me?
Right, well, just so you know for the metadata: RSSC YouTube videos are uploaded publicly. We don't do private links anymore.
Noted. Public uploads for RSSC videos. Is there a specific playlist you want them added to?
Not yet. Hey, is it going to rain this afternoon? I want to walk the dog before I start uploading.
I can't check real-time weather, but generally, check a local forecast app for the most accurate update.
Good point. I'll check my phone. Just wanted to make sure you had the public upload rule down.
I have that recorded. Let me know if you need help with the upload titles.
